data.title: Vacancies by Occupation

metadata.label: Keywords
metadata.value: Vacancies, Job openings, Occupation, Sector, Engineering, Healthcare, IT, Education, Finance, Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Statistical population
metadata.value: The statistical population includes all individuals aged 15 years and above who reside in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. The following are excluded: visitors to the Emirate who have stayed for less than six months, residents of institutions such as hospitals, psychiatric facilities, elderly care homes, orphanages, and hotels, members of the diplomatic corps, armed forces personnel, security camps, and palace residents.

metadata.label: Geographic coverage
metadata.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.

metadata.label: Statistical calculation method
metadata.value: Total number of vacant job positions classified by occupational category, as reported by establishments in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi on an annual basis.

data.description: Total number of vacancies broken down by occupational category in Abu Dhabi.

aiRecommendation.title: Invest in IT and Finance Talent to Meet Growing Sectoral Demand
aiRecommendation.title_ar: الاستثمار في مواهب تكنولوجيا المعلومات والمالية لتلبية الطلب القطاعي المتنامي
aiRecommendation.text: IT leads all occupational vacancy categories, followed closely by Finance and Healthcare. Focused upskilling and talent attraction programmes in these sectors will be essential to sustaining Abu Dhabi's economic diversification agenda.
aiRecommendation.text_ar: تتصدر تكنولوجيا المعلومات جميع فئات الوظائف الشاغرة المهنية، يليها المالية والرعاية الصحية عن كثب. ستكون برامج رفع المهارات وجذب المواهب المركّزة في هذه القطاعات ضرورية للحفاظ على أجندة التنويع الاقتصادي في أبوظبي.
aiRecommendation.reason: IT vacancy dominance reflects Abu Dhabi's push toward digital transformation and smart city initiatives. Finance and Healthcare vacancies signal sustained demand driven by economic growth and expanding public services. Education records the lowest vacancy count, suggesting a relatively stable supply-demand balance in that sector.
aiRecommendation.reason_ar: تعكس هيمنة شواغر تكنولوجيا المعلومات توجّه أبوظبي نحو التحول الرقمي ومبادرات المدن الذكية. تُشير شواغر المالية والرعاية الصحية إلى طلب مستدام مدفوع بالنمو الاقتصادي وتوسّع الخدمات العامة. تسجّل التعليم أدنى عدد من الشواغر، مما يوحي بتوازن نسبي بين العرض والطلب في ذلك القطاع.
